Do ALL of these, in order. Keep changes minimal.

   - creates an Animal with name/sound and notes="fleet-note"
   - asserts animal.notes == "fleet-note"

3) Run tools only via fleet-wsexec (see FLEET_TOOLS.md), in this order:

- You may ONLY edit under `invoices/` and `tests/` (project tree). Do not create app/fleet_marker.py.
- Use ONLY fleet-wsexec <tool-name>. Do NOT pip install.
- Do NOT skip django_test_fleet.
- If makemigrations/migrate/check/test_fleet fails, fix only Animal.notes + your test and re-run.
